[[Blind Faith]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Towers gain a 10% damage boost when the player has 25% of their total health left|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Justice''' is one of the curses that appears in the [[Null & Void Event]]. It can be voted for by the players every few waves. If voted for, it will apply a [[Damage Buff]] once a specific health value is reached. ==Effects== When applied, nothing will happen until the player reaches 25% of their base health. When this is done, all towers will receive a 10% [[Damage Buff]]. ==Trivia== *'''Justice''' is based on the [[wp:Justice (tarot card)|Justice]] tarot card. *How [[The Fool]] interacts with '''Justice''' depends on the order in which they are activated. **If '''Justice''' is activated first, [[The Fool]] being activated after it will count as reaching 25% of the base health, activating the [[Damage Buff]] with no effort. **If [[The Fool]] is activated first, '''Justice''''s [[Damage Buff]] will become impossible to achieve, as players will need to reduce the 1 base health down to 0.25, which is not possible to do through normal means. *'''Justice''' is the only curse that does not apply a negative effect. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Justice''' added. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[V1.80.0|v1.80.1d]] ** '''Justice''' removed. {{ModifierNavBox}}
